title: Mom and Me
text: Mothers joined their children to paint pots and celebrate together.
body:
Mom and Me brought mothers into school to create something with their children. Together they painted clay pots, adding bright colours and patterns at the table.

Some children came dressed for Krishna Janmashtami, with crowns, beads and festive clothes. Mothers sat beside them, guiding little hands and sharing the work.

The morning ended in front of a Happy Janmashtami backdrop, with mothers and children greeting the celebration side by side.

photos.alt: A mother and child painting a clay pot together
A child dressed as Krishna decorating a pot with his mother
A mother and child in front of the Happy Janmashtami display
